citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 11:00 on 06 July
2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by calling and leaving a voice mail. Licensee made contact back
but was unable to come to the facility. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a
violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
